app: OpenAI run (fresh userData; the model is the default the .env key gives: openai gpt-5.4-mini)
what: Title → 設定 → English (UI and so the new world's language); read the Model section and the inference store (openai, gpt-5.4-mini, no context window: the full prompt)

actions.eval: (() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Model')); if (!s) return 'no Model section'; s.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return s.innerText.slice(0, 600) })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const st = S.useInferenceStore.getState(); if (st.probe.status === 'ready') return JSON.stringify({ lang: document.documentElement.lang, config: st.config && { kind: st.config.kind, model: st.config.model }, probe: { reachable: st.probe.value.reachable, context: st.probe.value.context } }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'probe not ready' })()
